Navigating challenging quarter with 
Operational Discipline
4Q25 consolidated sales 
reached THB 39,935mn, declining by THB 886mn or -2.2% YoY.  
•PSC’s  sales  reached  THB 6,577mn, declining  by THB 251mn or -3.7% YoY, 
mainly  due to lower  sales  in the Glass  segment .
•CSC’s  sales  reached  THB 5,701mn, increasing  by THB 435mn or +8.3% YoY, 
robust  growth  in the Foods  and Non-Foods  segment,  particularly  snack  
and tissue  paper .
•H&TSC’s  sales  reached  THB 2,259mn, decreasing  by THB 67mn or -2.9% 
YoY, driven  by the divestment  of TSS and a decrease  of Healthcare  
supply  chain  sales .
•MSC‘s  sales  reached  THB 25,938mn, declining  by THB 997mn or -3.7% YoY, 
driven  by SSSG  of -3.3% due to the negative  impact  from  various  factors  
during  the quarter . 4Q25 consolidated net profit
reached THB 1,293mn, declining by THB 351mn or -21.4% YoY.  
•PSC’s net profit  reached  THB 739mn, increasing  by THB 150mn or +25.5% 
YoY, driven  by the Glass  Packaging  business  due to lower  input  costs  and 
improved  operational  efficiency .
•CSC’s net profit  reached  THB 369mn, decreasing  by THB 68mn or -15.6% 
YoY,  mainly  due to higher  advertising  and promotion  (A&P)  expenses  to 
support  new  product  launches .
•H&TSC ’s net profit  reached  THB 376mn, increasing  by THB 67mn or +21.8% 
YoY, supported  by favorable  product  mix and the divestment  of TSS.
•MSC ’s net profit  reached  THB 772mn, declining  by THB 539mn or
